purpose: Learn when to keep the frozen teacher rather than blindly restore it from low prototype floors. No production activation or authorization changes.
training: Freeze all existing teacher and utility-v2 networks/policy. Use existing TRAIN rows only. For each accepted teacher decision whose raw six-class expert top choice differs, train keep=0 vs use=1 from true labels: use only when raw expert is correct and teacher is wrong; both-wrong defaults keep. This includes counterfactual expert rejections of correct training teacher choices that the v2 policy itself protected. Never train on previously scored regressions or fresh reservation.
features: 20 bounded runtime-owned values: teacher probabilities5, raw expert probabilities6, teacher-domain onehot5, teacher-domain presence1, raw-expert rejection flag1, teacher margin1, expert margin1. Schema and complete frozen base model/policy fingerprints must match. No raw text in the trust bank.
fits: Exactly four SGD fits: linear or tanh8, seeds42/97, max200 epochs using existing early-stopped trainer. Balance available language/keep-use strata. Validation NLL uses development counterfactual rows; temperature grid0.5/0.75/1/1.5/2/3/5 uses calibration counterfactual rows. No new hyperparameter trials after held-out scoring.
policy: Runtime can only choose the original teacher or the exact already eligible utility-v2 proposal. Teacher abstention is unchanged; caller confidence/margin is unchanged. Choose trust cutoff per teacher domain from descending1.1/0.99/0.95/0.9/0.8/0.7/0.6/0.5/0, maximizing development language/outcome-balanced utility while preserving each previously correct TRAIN, DEVELOPMENT and CALIBRATION teacher choice. Ties keep stricter cutoff. Choose candidate by development utility, then smaller model, then NLL, then deterministic fit order. Include complete teacher fallback as a control.
fresh: Reserve ten parallel official-test groups for each transport_ticket/lists_createoradd/email_addcontact/iot_cleaning from checksum-pinned MASSIVE1.1, excluding every prior source-ID and normalized text. This is 80 new unsupported-only ar-SA/en-US observations, not a fresh positive or all-domain evaluation. Existing supported source groups are exhausted. Export weights/policy before reading reserved utterances for scoring.
evaluation: Report teacher, utility-v2, prototype-v1 and trust. Keep all 4301 previous observations explicitly observed. Include retention losses, accepted correct, unsupported refused, new negative-only results and descriptive bounded host timings. New source IDs remain parallel semantic groups. No test-driven threshold repair.
limits: Custom learned selection inspired by selective prediction, not a reproduction of cited research, a Jev clone, conformal coverage or evidence of production-level intelligence. Independent bilingual/mixed positive and physical-device evaluation remain required.
